name: WARA Reliability Assessment
description: Runs Microsoft's Well-Architected Reliability Assessment (collector + analyzer) one scope at a time, in restricted-egress SRE Agent sandboxes or anywhere PowerShell 7 runs, and turns the results into a provenance-tracked, prioritized findings report with month-over-month deltas, plus Linux reproduction of Start-WARAReport (PowerPoint, findings workbook) and a Word report with environment/criticality context. Read-only.

skills.name: wara-assessment
skills.description: Runs WARA for one scope via Invoke-WaraRun.ps1, verifies run provenance, and reviews the deterministic prioritized findings (remediate vs validate), publishing results to a repository or download links.
